about: Registry for check-doc-codes.mjs. 'built' codes must be in a listed source file; 'designed' codes are named by the documents as unbuilt and must carry a task id. Written for task Z-30 (2026-10-06). When a designed code lands in source the checker warns; the final documents task (X-DOCS-FINAL) moves it to 'built'.

zdr_connection_not_acknowledged.note: refusal: org ZDR on, own connection cannot do ZDR, no valid acknowledgement

zdr_connection_not_supported.note: refusal: kill switch off or the provider has no waiver route; acknowledging cannot help (Z-10 posture matrix)

zdr_explicit_request_not_supported_by_co.note: refusal: Temporary chat on a connection that cannot do ZDR; never waivable

zdr_decision_unavailable.note: refusal: a retention decision could not be made; ZDR stays on

zdr_waiver_route_mismatch.note: refusal: a waiver token used on any route but its one connection

zdr_waiver.note: the signed claim that carries the waiver

zdr_waived.note: the run retention class stamped on a waived run

zdr_posture_mismatch.note: refusal: delegated bearers of one request disagree on zdr or waiver, or a waiver at an unknown contract version (Z-10 posture matrix)

ZDR_WAIVER_ENABLED.note: Auth Core kill switch, default off

x-retention-decision.note: header that carries the signed decision into a token mint

retention:zdr-decide.task: Z-14 with the Control Plane principal bundle
retention:zdr-decide.note: scope of the BFF's retention-decision principal on audience control-policy
